chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from one of his companions, from Maymun al-Qaddah, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no worship more superior than the chastity of the belly and the private part.'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the most superior form of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates physical chastity to the highest rank of worship, emphasizing that guarding the two primary gates of desire—the stomach and the private part—is superior to ritual acts. This teaching reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'Iffah' (chastity) as a comprehensive state of being that purifies the soul and prepares the believer for deeper spiritual connection. By linking bodily discipline directly to worship, the Imam underscores the holistic nature of Islamic piety, where inner restraint manifests as outer devotion.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from one of his companions, from Maymoun Al Qaddah who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There is none from a worship more superior than the chastity of the belly and the private part’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from certain individuals of his people from Maymun al-Qaddah who has said the following: “
I heard abu Ja’far (a.s.) saying, ‘There is no worship better than the chastity in matters of stomach and genital organs.’”
